## Findings
**F1 — non-blocking hardening nit: hard dereference of `base` (`identityImport.ts:260`).** `(base as …).listImportMappings` throws `TypeError` for `base` `null`/`undefined`; `origin/main` returned a wrapper there (`{...undefined}` is legal). Reproduced in a scratchpad harness against both arms (main: ok / PR: `TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined`). Reachability: the only consumer builds the wrapper in a render-time `useMemo` (`ObjectView.tsx:1548-1556`); the Console gates on `AppContent.tsx:688` (`if (!dataSource …) return <LoadingScreen />`) ⇒ unreachable in tree. But `ObjectView` is exported with `dataSource: any` and guards `dataSource?.` itself (`:701`, `:715`, `:1120`, `:1585`), so an external host passing none now crashes this one branch. One-token fix: `(base as ImportMappingsCapableBase | null | undefined)?.listImportMappings?.bind(base)` + a one-line pin. Seat's call.

**F2 — wording (PR body / changeset), non-blocking.** PR "Scope note": "`identityImport.ts` sends `writeMode`, `matchFields`, `runAutomations` and `skipBlankMatchKey` explicitly" — wrong file: `identityImport.ts:207-218` sends `mode`/`matchBy`; the four are pinned by the **server** (`objectstack packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/admin-import-users.ts:299-307`), and `packages/rest/src/import-prepare.ts:336,339` applies artifact write semantics only as defaults (guards `writeMode === undefined` / `matchFields.length === 0`, never open here). The changeset (`.changeset/7740-identity-import-saved-mappings.md:30-33`) says "by the identity import path" — true read as the endpoint; its conclusion (a saved mapping renames columns and nothing more on this endpoint) is verified. Optional tighten to "by the identity endpoint".

**F3 — test-comment accuracy, cosmetic.** `identityImport.test.ts` "binds the forward…" says "Detached exactly the way the wizard detaches it"; the wizard re-attaches via `list.call(dataSource, objectName)` (`ImportWizard.tsx:1697`). The pin (detached, `this` undefined) is strictly stronger than the wizard's form and red on main — sound; comment misdescribes the wizard.

**F4 — ruling wording tension, resolved here (director seat).** Ruling 5565349507 says "absent when the base lacks it" but prescribes `base.listImportMappings?.bind(base)`, which writes the key unconditionally (control: no-capability base → `hasOwn=true`, `typeof undefined`). Ruling: the prescribed spelling governs; "absent" = "not offered" as the wizard reads it (`typeof`), and present-with-`undefined` is exactly the file's own stated idiom for the six withheld methods. Dev's implementation and pins (`typeof` both directions; `Object.hasOwn` only on the has-arm) are the correct reading. Closed, no change.

**F5 — newly reachable path, no defect.** With the selector live on `sys_user`, `handleSelectSavedMapping` (`ImportWizard.tsx:1712-1721`) can set `writeMode`/`matchFields` from an artifact's `mode`/`upsertKey`; `resolveIdentityWriteOptions` (`identityImport.ts:80-93`) throws a clear pre-batch error for `update` or a non-email/phone key, surfaced by the wizard's error path (`ImportWizard.tsx:2071-2078`). Explicit refusal per the wrapper's documented contract; server pins mode/matchFields regardless. Recorded so the behaviour is expressed.

**F6 — verification vs ruling bullet 3, note.** "Confirm … renders the selector on `sys_user` in the Setup app" was delivered as `identityImportSavedMapping.test.tsx` (real `ObjectStackAdapter` → real wrapper → real `ImportWizard`, only `fetch` stubbed), not a browser run; no screenshot/live evidence. `ObjectView`→wizard wiring (`:1548`, `:2978`) is unchanged, so the RTL pin covers the changed seam. Accepted as sufficient; optional dogfood post-landing.
